name: Zafrani Pulao
instructions: 1. Soak saffron strands in warm milk for 20 minutes to release flavor and color.
2. Rinse and soak basmati rice for 30 minutes, then parboil in water with bay leaves, cloves, and cinnamon until 75% cooked.
3. Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan and lightly toast the almonds, cashews, and raisins until golden; set aside.
4. In the same pan, layer the parboiled rice, drizzle with the saffron milk, sugar, and rose water.
5. Cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat (dum) for 10-15 minutes until rice is fully tender and fragrant.
6. Gently fluff with a fork and garnish with toasted dry fruits before serving.
description: Zafrani Pulao is an iconic dish of the Awadhi cuisine of Uttar Pradesh. Historically served in the royal courts of Lucknow, it represents the sophistication of Mughal-influenced culinary arts, characterized by its vibrant golden hue from saffron and the delicate, aromatic balance of spices and sweetness.
